newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine central government deficit fell in April.
newsitem.headline: Argentine central government deficit fell in April.

text.p: Argentina's central government deficit in April fell to $410.4 million from $613 million in April last year, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
Total income rose by $95 million from the same month last year, "mainly derived from a rise in tax revenue for the Treasury," the ministry said in a statement. Total spending fell by $107.2 million.
The April deficit compares with a central government shortfall of $550.2 million in March.

The Economy Ministry statement, comparing the figures with last April's, said: "The drop in spending was mainly achieved by a reduction in spending destined to finance the deficit in social security institutions,"
The government did not release details of current or capital income and spending for the month.
